# Distribution catalog

Every All/slim package and platform combination implemented in this checkout is listed below. All includes every supported database; the other profiles include only their named database. Every CLI variant exposes command `grate`. New package-manager identities require publication or channel acceptance before public installation.

[![Release builds](https://github.com/grate-devs/grate/actions/workflows/build.yml/badge.svg?branch=main)](https://github.com/grate-devs/grate/actions/workflows/build.yml?query=branch%3Amain)
[![CI tests](https://github.com/grate-devs/grate/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg?branch=main)](https://github.com/grate-devs/grate/actions/workflows/ci.yml?query=branch%3Amain)
[![Database compatibility](https://github.com/grate-devs/grate/actions/workflows/integration-tests.yml/badge.svg?branch=main)](https://github.com/grate-devs/grate/actions/workflows/integration-tests.yml?query=branch%3Amain)

The badges show the latest **main workflow** results. They do not assert success for an individual package or public registry availability. Each row links to release workflow runs: open the relevant revision/run and its profile/platform job and retained artifact. For a PR, use that PR's checks instead of the main badges. GitHub's native [status badges](https://docs.github.com/en/actions/how-tos/monitor-workflows/add-a-status-badge) apply to workflows; per-job results remain in the run.

`<version>` is the package SemVer; a release tag may additionally have a `v` prefix. ZIP/MSI/Debian filenames below are the exact release asset contract. Casks and WinGet reuse those payloads. Stable Docker aliases and the all-in-one compatibility image are listed separately from unique builds.

This page is generated from the shared profile/release-asset catalog, library IDs and target frameworks. Refresh it after changing those inputs:

```powershell
pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts/distributions/Update-DistributionCatalog.ps1
```

Shared preflight runs the generator with `-Check` and rejects stale content. Edit the catalog or generator rather than the generated tables. [Build/test instructions](distributions.md) · [Release runbook](ReleaseProcess.md)
